text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to team training,
Haru Urara was singing a song.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Go, go, go! You can do it, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Run, run, Ran Ran Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Guess what? I was thinking up a fight song for our team!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: In baseball, everyone on the team sings songs together to cheer each other on!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I read about it in a manga yesterday!

Haru Urara puffed out her chest with pride.
I grew a little curious about what kind of song she had come up with.
choice_data_list: Will you let me hear it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure thing~! Even though it's still work in progress!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, go, Urara, you can do it♪
Run, run, run, tra-la-la Urara♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ah, but I can come up with something right away!
Next up is, umm...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, go, like a fast cheetah!
Hop, hop, skip, like a bouncy bunny!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Toot-toot goes the elephant!
Roar-roar goes the bear!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ribbit ribbit, ribbit ribbit, Mr. Froggy!
Flutter flutter, flutter flutter, Ms. Butterfly!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's all dance together nicely!
Happily, happily, let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tra-la-la! Lu-lu-loo!
Ta-da-da-daan! Sparkle-shiiine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that was so fun! We gotta
teach everyone our fight song too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Umm, what were the lyrics again...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! I totally forgot!

Afterward, improvising cheer songs became
a trend within the team, and <chrname> seemed
to be inspired by it as well.
